package main

// Overlaid into the explicit Gateway checkout; no Gateway file is changed.
// Prepare compiles dependencies before the bounded producer is started.
import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type agentReceiptPrepared struct {
	Bin, Runtime, Credentials    string
	AdapterSHA256, RuntimeSHA256 string
}

func agentReceiptFileHash(path string) (string, error) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	hash := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]), nil
}

// Replace one canonical flag in place; split and repeated flags are refused.
func agentReceiptReplaceFlag(argv []string, name, value string) ([]string, error) {
	out := append([]string(nil), argv...)
	index := -1
	for i, arg := range out {
		if arg == name {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("split %s flag", name)
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, name+"=") {
			if index != -1 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate %s flag", name)
			}
			index = i
		}
	}
	if index == -1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing %s flag", name)
	}
	out[index] = name + "=" + value
	return out, nil
}

func agentReceiptAdapt(spec sourceSpec, prepared agentReceiptPrepared, stdio bool) (sourceSpec, error) {
	var err error
	spec.argv, err = agentReceiptReplaceFlag(spec.argv, "--credentials", prepared.Credentials)
	if err != nil {
		return spec, err
	}
	if stdio {
		spec.argv, err = agentReceiptReplaceFlag(spec.argv, "--runtime", prepared.Runtime)
		if err != nil {
			return spec, err
		}
	}
	return spec, nil
}

// Independent of adaptation: call immediately before execution or publication.
func agentReceiptValidateSpec(spec sourceSpec, prepared agentReceiptPrepared, stdio bool) error {
	adapter := filepath.Join(prepared.Bin, "adapter-mcp")
	for _, path := range []string{adapter, prepared.Runtime, prepared.Credentials} {
		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) || filepath.Clean(path) != path {
			return fmt.Errorf("prepared path must be explicit and clean: %q", path)
		}
	}
	if len(spec.argv) == 0 || spec.argv[0] != adapter {
		return fmt.Errorf("adapter identity mismatch")
	}
	for _, flag := range []struct {
		name, value string
		count       int
	}{
		{"--runtime", prepared.Runtime, map[bool]int{false: 0, true: 1}[stdio]},
		{"--credentials", prepared.Credentials, 1},
	} {
		count := 0
		for _, arg := range spec.argv[1:] {
			if arg == flag.name {
				return fmt.Errorf("split %s identity flag", flag.name)
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(arg, flag.name+"=") {
				count++
				if arg != flag.name+"="+flag.value {
					return fmt.Errorf("%s identity mismatch", flag.name)
				}
			}
		}
		if count != flag.count {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s identity count: got %d want %d", flag.name, count, flag.count)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func agentReceiptValidatePrepared(prepared agentReceiptPrepared) error {
	for _, binary := range []struct{ path, hash string }{
		{filepath.Join(prepared.Bin, "adapter-mcp"), prepared.AdapterSHA256},
		{prepared.Runtime, prepared.RuntimeSHA256},
	} {
		hash, err := agentReceiptFileHash(binary.path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if len(binary.hash) != 64 || hash != binary.hash {
			return fmt.Errorf("prepared binary hash mismatch: %s", binary.path)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func TestAgentConsumerReceiptPrepare(t *testing.T) {
	if !t.Run("command-identity", agentReceiptIdentityChecks) {
		return
	}
	output := os.Getenv("JP_AGENT_GATEWAY_PREPARED")
	if output == "" {
		t.Fatal("JP_AGENT_GATEWAY_PREPARED required")
	}
	dir, err := os.MkdirTemp(os.Getenv("TMPDIR"), "receipt-dependencies-")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bin, runtime := buildMCPStandIns(t, dir)
	credentials := filepath.Join(dir, "credentials.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(credentials, []byte(`{"SERVICE_TOKEN":"secret-token","token":"fixture-live-credential"}`), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	adapterHash, err := agentReceiptFileHash(filepath.Join(bin, "adapter-mcp"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	runtimeHash, err := agentReceiptFileHash(runtime)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(agentReceiptPrepared{Bin: bin, Runtime: runtime, Credentials: credentials, AdapterSHA256: adapterHash, RuntimeSHA256: runtimeHash})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(output, raw, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func agentConsumerReceiptFixture(t *testing.T, prepared agentReceiptPrepared, stdio bool) map[string]any {
	target := newWriteStandIn(t, customerTools)
	bindingText := customerBinding(target.URL, "")
	owners := map[string]any{"query": map[string]string{"operation": "read", "effect": "read-external"}, "sibling": map[string]string{"operation": "read", "effect": "read-external"}}
	if stdio {
		bindingText = `{"bindingVersion":"2","platform":"tickets","operations":{"live":{"shape":"mcp","server":{"image":"example/receipt-server:1@` + testImageDigest + `"},"tools":["query"],"toolTaxonomies":{"query":{"operation":"read","effect":"read-external"}},"licence":"fixture"}}}`
		delete(owners, "sibling")
	}
	f, req, _, baseAdapt := customerFixture(t, prepared.Bin, bindingText, false)
	if stdio {
		req.endpoint = ""
	}
	adapt := func(spec sourceSpec) sourceSpec {
		spec, err := agentReceiptAdapt(baseAdapt(spec), prepared, stdio)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return spec
	}
	check := func(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) ([]byte, error) {
		spec = adapt(spec)
		if err := agentReceiptValidateSpec(spec, prepared, stdio); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return runCheck(ctx, spec)
	}
	if _, err := connect(context.Background(), req, f.host, check); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cfg, bindings, err := loadEngineConfig(f.config, stubAccounts(stubUsers))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	p := cfg.platforms[0]
	service, signer := testService(t)
	for name, spec := range deriveSources(cfg, bindings) {
		spec = adapt(spec)
		if err := agentReceiptValidateSpec(spec, prepared, stdio); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		service.sources[name] = spec
	}
	cfg.listen = strings.TrimPrefix(signer.URL, "http://")
	cfg.mcp = &mcpConfig{listen: "127.0.0.1:0", sessions: 128, idleSeconds: 60, concurrency: 8, callsPerMinute: 1000}
	front, err := newMCPServer(cfg, bindings, nil, f.config)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	httpFront := httptest.NewServer(front.httpHandler())
	t.Cleanup(httpFront.Close)
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(f.config+".descriptors", strings.TrimPrefix(p.operationDescriptors["live"], "sha256:")+".json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	executable, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(prepared.Bin, "adapter-mcp"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	hash := sha256.Sum256(executable)
	adapter := map[string]string{"name": "adapter-mcp", "version": "0", "digest": "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])}
	approval := map[string]any{"platform": req.platform, "binding": "tickets@" + digestOf(bindingText), "operation": "live", "toolTaxonomies": owners}
	// Stdio's signed identity names the operator-pinned server image; remote
	// names the adapter executable and authenticates endpoint/server separately.
	if stdio {
		adapter = map[string]string{"name": "example/receipt-server", "version": "1", "digest": testImageDigest}
	} else {
		approval["endpoint"] = target.URL
	}
	return map[string]any{"url": httpFront.URL + "/mcp", "snapshotText": string(data), "snapshotDigest": p.operationDescriptors["live"], "tool": "query", "trust": map[string]any{"publicKey": hex.EncodeToString(service.publicKey), "authority": "gateway:test", "adapter": adapter}, "approval": approval}
}
func TestAgentConsumerReceiptProducer(t *testing.T) {
	output := os.Getenv("JP_AGENT_GATEWAY_OUTPUT")
	if output == "" {
		t.Fatal("JP_AGENT_GATEWAY_OUTPUT required")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("JP_AGENT_GATEWAY_PREPARED"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var prepared agentReceiptPrepared
	if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &prepared); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := agentReceiptValidatePrepared(prepared); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fixture := agentConsumerReceiptFixture(t, prepared, false)
	fixture["stdio"] = agentConsumerReceiptFixture(t, prepared, true)
	raw, err = json.Marshal(fixture)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(output, raw, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Log("actual remote and stdio connect/capture adapter signer and public frontend ready")
	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Minute)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		if _, err := os.Stat(output + ".stop"); err == nil {
			t.Log("consumer stop handshake received")
			return
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	t.Fatal("bounded producer lifetime expired")
}

// These handwritten checks use the pinned Gateway command builder and start no
// adapter, runtime, server or producer process. Prepare runs them in normal CI.
func agentReceiptIdentityChecks(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("Replacement", agentReceiptIdentityReplacement)
	t.Run("ReplacementRefusals", agentReceiptIdentityReplacementRefusals)
	t.Run("Guards", agentReceiptIdentityGuards)
	t.Run("PreparedHashes", agentReceiptIdentityPreparedHashes)
	t.Run("ExplicitPaths", agentReceiptIdentityExplicitPaths)
}

func TestAgentReceiptIdentity(t *testing.T) { agentReceiptIdentityChecks(t) }

func agentReceiptIdentityFixture(t *testing.T) (agentReceiptPrepared, sourceSpec) {
	t.Helper()
	dir := t.TempDir()
	prepared := agentReceiptPrepared{Bin: filepath.Join(dir, "bin"), Runtime: filepath.Join(dir, "runtime"), Credentials: filepath.Join(dir, "credentials.json")}
	argv := mcpServerArgv(filepath.Join(prepared.Bin, "adapter-mcp"), operation{image: "example/receipt-server:1@" + testImageDigest, tools: []string{"query"}}, filepath.Join(dir, "original.json"), "docker", "https://fixture.invalid", "--check", "--timeout=7s")
	return prepared, sourceSpec{argv: argv}
}

func agentReceiptIdentityReplacement(t *testing.T) {
	prepared, original := agentReceiptIdentityFixture(t)
	before := append([]string(nil), original.argv...)
	got, err := agentReceiptAdapt(original, prepared, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []string{filepath.Join(prepared.Bin, "adapter-mcp"), "--image=example/receipt-server:1@" + testImageDigest, "--credentials=" + prepared.Credentials, "--runtime=" + prepared.Runtime, "--tools=query", "--check", "--timeout=7s", "--endpoint=https://fixture.invalid"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got.argv, want) {
		t.Fatalf("runtime replacement/order mismatch: got %q want %q", got.argv, want)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(original.argv, before) {
		t.Fatal("adaptation modified caller argv")
	}
	if err := agentReceiptValidateSpec(got, prepared, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	remote := sourceSpec{argv: mcpServerArgv(filepath.Join(prepared.Bin, "adapter-mcp"), operation{url: "https://fixture.invalid/mcp", bearer: "SERVICE_TOKEN", headers: []string{"X-Fixture:yes"}, tools: []string{"query"}}, "original.json", "docker", "", "--check")}
	got, err = agentReceiptAdapt(remote, prepared, false)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want = []string{filepath.Join(prepared.Bin, "adapter-mcp"), "--url=https://fixture.invalid/mcp", "--credentials=" + prepared.Credentials, "--bearer=SERVICE_TOKEN", "--header=X-Fixture:yes", "--tools=query", "--check"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got.argv, want) {
		t.Fatalf("remote replacement/order mismatch: got %q want %q", got.argv, want)
	}
	if err := agentReceiptValidateSpec(got, prepared, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func agentReceiptIdentityReplacementRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	prepared, original := agentReceiptIdentityFixture(t)
	for _, name := range []string{"--runtime", "--credentials"} {
		for _, kind := range []string{"missing", "duplicate", "split"} {
			t.Run(name+"/"+kind, func(t *testing.T) {
				argv := []string{}
				for _, arg := range original.argv {
					if strings.HasPrefix(arg, name+"=") {
						switch kind {
						case "duplicate":
							argv = append(argv, arg, arg)
						case "split":
							argv = append(argv, name, strings.TrimPrefix(arg, name+"="))
						}
					} else {
						argv = append(argv, arg)
					}
				}
				_, err := agentReceiptAdapt(sourceSpec{argv: argv}, prepared, true)
				if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), kind+" "+name+" flag") {
					t.Fatalf("expected %s %s replacement refusal, got %v", kind, name, err)
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func agentReceiptIdentityGuards(t *testing.T) {
	prepared, original := agentReceiptIdentityFixture(t)
	valid, err := agentReceiptAdapt(original, prepared, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, flag, replacement, want string
		remove, duplicate             bool
	}{
		{name: "adapter", replacement: "adapter-mcp", want: "adapter identity mismatch"},
		{name: "wrong-runtime", flag: "--runtime", replacement: "--runtime=docker", want: "--runtime identity mismatch"},
		{name: "missing-runtime", flag: "--runtime", remove: true, want: "--runtime identity count"},
		{name: "duplicate-runtime", flag: "--runtime", duplicate: true, want: "--runtime identity count"},
		{name: "split-runtime", flag: "--runtime", replacement: "--runtime", want: "split --runtime identity flag"},
		{name: "wrong-credentials", flag: "--credentials", replacement: "--credentials=ambient.json", want: "--credentials identity mismatch"},
		{name: "missing-credentials", flag: "--credentials", remove: true, want: "--credentials identity count"},
		{name: "duplicate-credentials", flag: "--credentials", duplicate: true, want: "--credentials identity count"},
		{name: "split-credentials", flag: "--credentials", replacement: "--credentials", want: "split --credentials identity flag"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			argv := []string{}
			for i, arg := range valid.argv {
				if tc.flag == "" && i == 0 {
					arg = tc.replacement
				} else if tc.flag != "" && strings.HasPrefix(arg, tc.flag+"=") {
					if tc.remove {
						continue
					}
					if tc.duplicate {
						argv = append(argv, arg)
					} else {
						arg = tc.replacement
					}
				}
				argv = append(argv, arg)
			}
			err := agentReceiptValidateSpec(sourceSpec{argv: argv}, prepared, true)
			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.want) {
				t.Fatalf("expected %s refusal, got %v", tc.name, err)
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("remote-runtime", func(t *testing.T) {
		argv := mcpServerArgv(filepath.Join(prepared.Bin, "adapter-mcp"), operation{url: "https://fixture.invalid/mcp", tools: []string{"query"}}, prepared.Credentials, "docker", "")
		argv = append(argv, "--runtime="+prepared.Runtime)
		err := agentReceiptValidateSpec(sourceSpec{argv: argv}, prepared, false)
		if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "--runtime identity count") {
			t.Fatalf("expected remote runtime refusal, got %v", err)
		}
	})
}

func agentReceiptIdentityPreparedHashes(t *testing.T) {
	prepared, _ := agentReceiptIdentityFixture(t)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(prepared.Bin, 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, path := range []string{filepath.Join(prepared.Bin, "adapter-mcp"), prepared.Runtime} {
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("handwritten identity fixture"), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	var err error
	prepared.AdapterSHA256, err = agentReceiptFileHash(filepath.Join(prepared.Bin, "adapter-mcp"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	prepared.RuntimeSHA256 = prepared.AdapterSHA256
	if err := agentReceiptValidatePrepared(prepared); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, path := range []string{filepath.Join(prepared.Bin, "adapter-mcp"), prepared.Runtime} {
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("changed handwritten fixture"), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := agentReceiptValidatePrepared(prepared); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "prepared binary hash mismatch") {
			t.Fatalf("expected prepared binary hash refusal, got %v", err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("handwritten identity fixture"), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}

func agentReceiptIdentityExplicitPaths(t *testing.T) {
	prepared := agentReceiptPrepared{Bin: "bin", Runtime: "runtime", Credentials: "credentials.json"}
	spec := sourceSpec{argv: []string{"bin/adapter-mcp", "--runtime=runtime", "--credentials=credentials.json"}}
	err := agentReceiptValidateSpec(spec, prepared, true)
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "prepared path must be explicit and clean") {
		t.Fatalf("expected explicit prepared path refusal, got %v", err)
	}
}
